1.1.0.message: Added the stopOnError option, the unknown-event and unused-variable rules, the fix-brackets flag, and forge.lint/core with checkScript and fromMetadata. The config now loads in ESM bots and as forgelint.config.cjs or .mjs. Argument count errors now end with the function's usage. ForgeScript is an optional peer dependency now. Only forge.lint and forge.lint/core can be imported.
1.1.0.author: daisukidayo
